policies.sentence: Students must disable AI code completion, extensions and built-in LLMs in their editor or IDE.
Students must not use AI autocomplete tools or coding assistants such as Copilot.
Students may use IDEs and built-in autocomplete when AI features are disabled.
Students may use AI suggestions and coding assistants productively and responsibly.
Students must be able to tell whether AI code completion is enabled.
Code produced by Copilot or advanced code-completion tools counts as others' code and must be shown as own work.
Copilot can almost fully autocomplete code when you start typing.
Students must interact with AI exclusively through browser-based chatbots.
